statBlock.name: Champion
statBlock.description: A seasoned fighter whose battlefield or arena record makes them influential among soldiers and sought after by rulers.

sections.Traits: Indomitable (2/day). The champion can reroll a failed saving throw.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks with a Greatsword or Shortbow.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. Add 7 (2d6) slashing damage if the champion has more than half of its maximum hit points.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Add 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the champion has more than half of its maximum hit points.
sections.Bonus actions: Second Wind (recharges after a short or long rest). The champion regains 20 hit points.

statBlock.name: Chitine
statBlock.description: A multi-armed scout or warrior of a web-built colony. Chitines serve Lolth and defend their choldrith leaders.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. The chitine has advantage on saves against being charmed. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the chitine has disadvantage on attacks and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.
Web Sense. While touching a web, the chitine knows the exact location of every other creature touching it.
Web Walker. Webbing imposes no movement restrictions on the chitine.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Choldrith
statBlock.description: A spiderlike priest of Lolth that directs chitine colonies. Choldriths compete for standing and raise more chitines when their sovereign permits it.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. The choldrith has advantage on saves against being charmed. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Spider Climb. The choldrith can climb difficult surfaces and cross ceilings upside down without an ability check.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the choldrith has disadvantage on attacks and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.
Web Sense. While touching a web, the choldrith knows the exact location of every other creature touching it.
Web Walker. Webbing imposes no movement restrictions on the choldrith.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
Web (Recharge 5–6). Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. A hit restrains the target in webbing. The target can use an action to break free with a successful DC 11 Strength check. Attacks can destroy the webbing, which has AC 10, 5 HP, vulnerability to fire damage and immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
The choldrith is a 4th-level cleric spellcaster using Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Guidance, Mending, Resistance, Thaumaturgy.
1st level (4 slots). Bane, Healing Word, Sanctuary, Shield of Faith.
2nd level (3 slots). Hold Person, Spiritual Weapon (dagger).

statBlock.name: Cloud Giant Smiling One
statBlock.description: A cloud giant trickster who prizes deception, illusion, and the advantage of an unexpected form.

sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The giant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Morningstar attacks.
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. Add 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage if the giant had advantage on the attack roll.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage. Add 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage if the giant had advantage on the attack roll.
Change Shape. The giant magically becomes a Beast or Humanoid it has seen, or returns to its true form. Its equipment merges with the new form. Size is the only statistic that changes. It returns to its true form when it dies.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The giant uses Charisma (spell save DC 15) and needs no material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Light.
3/day each. Feather Fall, Fly, Misty Step, Telekinesis.
1/day each. Control Weather, Gaseous Form.
sections.Spellcasting:
The giant is a 5th-level bard spellcaster using Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Vicious Mockery.
1st level (4 slots). Cure Wounds, Disguise Self, Silent Image, Tasha’s Hideous Laughter.
2nd level (3 slots). Invisibility, Suggestion.
3rd level (2 slots). Major Image, Tongues.

statBlock.name: Conjurer
statBlock.description: A wizard who brings in extraplanar creatures for protection or war and can summon materials out of thin air.

sections.Armor: AC 15 while Mage Armor is active.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Benign Transportation. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. The conjurer can instead choose a space in range occupied by a willing Small or Medium creature, swapping places with it. The conjurer regains this option after casting a conjuration spell of 1st level or higher.
sections.Spellcasting:
The conjurer is a 9th-level wizard spellcaster using Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Mage Hand, Poison Spray, Prestidigitation.
1st level (4 slots). Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Unseen Servant.
2nd level (3 slots). Cloud of Daggers, Misty Step, Web.
3rd level (3 slots). Fireball, Stinking Cloud.
4th level (3 slots). Evard’s Black Tentacles, Stoneskin.
5th level (2 slots). Cloudkill, Conjure Elemental.
The prepared spells that recharge Benign Transportation are Unseen Servant, Cloud of Daggers, Misty Step, Web, Stinking Cloud, Evard’s Black Tentacles, Cloudkill, and Conjure Elemental.

statBlock.name: Darkling
statBlock.description: A reclusive fey that prefers darkness and fights with a dagger.

sections.Traits:
Death Flash. When the darkling dies, its body and possessions burn to ash, with metal and magic objects surviving. The resulting nonmagical flash reaches 10 ft. from the darkling. A creature in that radius that can see the flash must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save or be blinded until the end of its next turn.
Light Sensitivity. In bright light, the darkling has disadvantage on attacks and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. Add 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the darkling had advantage on the attack roll.

statBlock.name: Darkling Elder
statBlock.description: A darkling elder uses magical darkness to set up devastating close-range attacks.

sections.Traits: Death Burn. When the elder dies, its body and possessions burn to ash, with metal and magic objects surviving. Magical light flashes out to 10 ft., and every creature in that radius makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) radiant damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn if it can see the flash. A successful save halves the damage and avoids the blindness.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Add 10 (3d6) piercing damage if the elder had advantage on the attack roll.
Darkness (recharges after a short or long rest). Cast Darkness using Wisdom and without components.

statBlock.name: Death Kiss
statBlock.description: A floating beholderkin whose ten tentacles hold prey while it feeds.

sections.Traits: Lightning Blood. When a creature within 5 ft. hits the death kiss with a melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damage, that creature takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks. The death kiss can replace up to three attacks with Blood Drain, with at most one replacement for each tentacle that is grappling a creature.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage. A creature of Huge size or smaller is also grappled (escape DC 14) and stays restrained until the grapple ends. That tentacle cannot attack a different target while the grapple lasts. The death kiss has ten tentacles.
Blood Drain. A creature grappled by one of the death kiss’s tentacles makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage, and the death kiss regains hit points equal to half that damage.
